the gravitational instability of Bose-Einstein condensates in the presence of a confining potential is a nonlinear effect that is due to stimulated scattering of the bosonic particles by gravity, and that this effect is the origin of the formation of Bose star-like objects.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the gravitational instability of a Bose gas is not only a linear instability, but also a nonlinear one.
the gravitational instability of a Bose condensate in a small volume is not a collisionless instability.
